description: Engine §4.1 and §6: an unused root pattern does not split another erased rule and its canonical empty output.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution fewest #·zz
%rule text $r:other C
%conditions $r ≅ #·other
%rule probe $w:wrap
%conditions $w ≅ #r2
%rule wrap r2
%rule r2 X
%rule other (r4 ≻ B) :: ∅ | [r4]
%erased
%rule r4 B | ε
%rule zz B B B
